hypotheses.evaluator: Uniform independent ordered four-root product conditioned on public reset; qualification and sampling strata do not restrict H.
hypotheses.family: Prior 648 full-behavior root types plus 8 direct input/not-input roots. Compatible reset DSL; exact complete-behavior deduplication.
hypotheses.sampling: One direct, one interaction, one delay-or-latch, one repetition root; sensor slots randomly permuted.

interfaces.B: Grounded bookkeeping, full authenticated ledger and observed traces, tested/untried legal IDs, budget6, reset fact and nonexhaustive action scope. No prior model prose.
interfaces.D: First choice identical to B. Before steps2..6, fresh evidence/delta/relation/exact-trace prediction analysis, then independent legal selector. Analysis never executes.
interfaces.T: Same call structure as D. Apply Time/Relation/Direction to evidence-derived relation/extrapolation with a distinct exact alternative trace.
interfaces.analysis: Schema in interface.py. Extra exact observed endpoint copies and input-relation enum make limited evidence fidelity mechanically auditable; free relation/delta prose receives no truth credit.
interfaces.analysis_decoder: Public-only grammar; B NONE is legal when only one distinct executed probe exists. Model chooses PREDICTION or INSUFFICIENT_DELTA freely. Model chooses legal untested target and reference IDs; no utility ordering. Prose supports up to12 ASCII tokens/120 chars per field; exact trace dimensions follow chosen probe; T alternative differs in at least one model-chosen bit. All field values remain model choices; no hidden outcomes enter.
interfaces.choice: Same opaque legal-ID constrained decoder; all82 legal IDs including repeats remain legal. Proposed tests are not compulsory.
interfaces.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_DELTA is valid, not an error, excluded from prediction accuracy denominator, never retried. Its use is reported against availability of simple controlled endpoint differences, not assumed incorrect when such a difference exists.
interfaces.invalid: All analysis syntax/reference/shape validity is constrained prospectively. A durable complete response is never retried for reasoning quality. Unexpected transport/language violation stops the campaign; preserve all raw evidence.
interfaces.persistence: Only authenticated executed history and deterministic bookkeeping persist. The current fresh analysis enters only its own choice; previous proposals, scores and explanations are never injected.
interfaces.sealed: Identical prediction messages/grammar in all arms after six discovery probes; no analysis or receipt scores in these prompts.

interpretation_limits: Finite compatible machines, known actions and fixed sensors are scaffolding, not unrestricted open-world proof.
D/T add inference calls and explicit trace predictions; D/T versus B does not isolate organization from extra computation.
T versus D has matched call count but different prompt/output size and explicit alternative predictions; its effect is for that bundle.
A true predicted trace does not prove the accompanying relation; faithfulness checks cover references, copied endpoints and input structure only.
Matched prediction-testing comparisons and post-contradiction changes are observational; do not romanticize or claim causal adaptation.
Two sealed queries per world are32 endpoints/arm; retention screen is not powered noninferiority.
INSUFFICIENT_DELTA is allowed. Mechanism coverage is needed to recommend scaling, but abstention is not automatically wrong.

metrics.axis_cards: Scoped temporal onset and contextual/order cards entailed by H, inherited definitions; no global independence or infinite-horizon claims.
metrics.information: Exact finite H; realized and expected bits, selected midrank/regret among82 legal probes, H and log2H.
metrics.prediction: Whole-trace exact plus per-step/per-bit accuracy. Invalid complete traces receive zero credit.
metrics.prediction_receipts: Independent exact trace and endpoint/syntax checks; no eloquence or learned semantic truth judge.
metrics.repeat: An identical executed reset sequence already in this arm/world ledger.
metrics.useful_contrast: Prior registered structural comparison (one-action prefix/suffix extension or adjacent swap), actual endpoint delta, realized information>1e-12; at most once per decision.

raw_first: commit rules before scientific world selection
commit raw manifest before any scientific scoring

receipts.adaptation: After an eventually tested receipt has any wrong bit, count changes in the next selected probe and next valid prediction target/trace. These are receipt-level descriptive associations, not proof the contradiction caused adaptation.
receipts.alternatives: T alternatives must differ in at least one bit for the same probe. A discriminating executed outcome matches exactly one complete primary/alternative trace; neither-match is reported without forced selection.
receipts.delta_validity: Valid two-observation comparison requires distinct executed IDs, copied endpoints matching receipts, and a sequence-relation label correct under public syntax. Controlled endpoint delta additionally requires a one-step extension/adjacent swap and differing endpoints. Neither proves the causal explanation.
receipts.identity: World, arm, decision, evidence references, full prediction, alternative when T, analysis hash, base+adapter identity and authenticated source-response sequence.
receipts.order: Analysis response -> signed non-authoritative prediction receipt -> independent choice -> executed trace. Raw scores remain null.
receipts.prediction: Full sensor trace in fixed public sensor order. Free prose is an unscored gloss.
receipts.statuses: supported = every predicted bit matches; contradicted = no predicted bit matches; partially_matched = some but not all match; never_tested = no later exact target execution. Also report any-bit contradiction, including partial matches, so partial credit does not conceal falsification.
receipts.target: A legal unexecuted probe ID. Scientific sealed queries absent. Only exact eventual execution of the proposed ID scores the receipt; no hypothetical/oracle test.

screening.linked_vs_nonlinked: The gate uses B non-prediction choices at the same world/step as the prediction-testing choice. Within-D/T prediction-testing versus ignoring means are also reported but cannot be causally interpreted and may have empty groups. First probes are excluded from that within-arm comparison. The matched-B benchmark avoids requiring the model to ignore its own prediction merely to form a comparison group.
screening.type: Exploratory screening only; no conventional significance requirement; publish all16 paired differences.

selection_rule: Recommend T only if T-B and T-D both pass. Otherwise recommend D only if D-B passes. Otherwise NO_SCALE_UP. Recommendation never launches a study.
technical_recovery: Never repeat a durable complete response. An incomplete technical request can resume identical frozen input/settings with authenticated attempt/interruption records, maximum3 attempts. No choice executes before response is durable. Corrupt/torn authentication stops for review.

world_admission.IDs: Shuffle82 legal sequences with prospective PRNG, assign P000..P081; shared by matched arms.
world_admission.direct: At least one singleton actuator changes a reset sensor; one actual direct input/not-input root also required by sampling.
world_admission.freshness: Exclude prior causal, active, triangulation, inquiry pilot and inquiry confirmation scientific and engineering graphs and this engineering set.
world_admission.modifier: A change in the second-action effect between B from reset and B after A, for some distinct A/B and sensor.
world_admission.oracle: Six legal probes, greedy expected information gain; at least five positive realized-information steps, at least eight bits, and both reserved outcomes identifiable. Offline admission only.
world_admission.sealed: Two seeded distinct length3 patterns per candidate, removed from all84 before ID assignment. Internally changing, distinct complete traces; never an allowed prefix.
world_admission.temporal: AB versus BA endpoint difference, or AAA first versus third observation difference (identical current actuator bit, different history).
